Album cover::Youngblood Brass Band - Pax.label: Tru Thoughts
Album cover::Youngblood Brass Band - Pax.verified_against: Timothy J. Reynolds' own portfolio at turnislefthome.com, on his page for this cover: 'Art & Sons, a small studio out of Madison, WI commissioned me to [re]design the cover art for Youngblood Brass Band'. The image here is served from that same Wix site. The release itself is confirmed on Discogs — Youngblood Brass Band, Pax Volumi, Tru Thoughts, UK, 2013 (TRUCD278 / TRULP278, master 680660).
notes: Credited as ILLUSTRATOR, not designer. Reynolds states plainly on his own page that he 'didn't design any packaging/graphic design/etc' — only the illustration. The archive keeps that distinction.
The work was a commissioned RE-design: Art & Sons brought him in to reinterpret cover art the band had outgrown.

A web summary credited the original art to 'Scott Pauli and Tim Reynolds'. Reynolds' own page does not mention Pauli, so Pauli is not credited here — the earlier artwork's authorship is left open rather than guessed at.
